title: no-op update and status create junk commits
description: pebbles update <id> with no --title/--description, and pebbles status <id> to the current status, bump updated_at and create a jj commit that changes nothing meaningful. Since list ordering is updated_at-descending, no-ops also reorder output. Acceptance: operations detect no observable change and return early - no file write, no index write, no jj commit; CLI prints a no-changes message. Test: jj_integration t15 asserts no new commit and unchanged file.
